name: The Underpulse Network
description: After 'Promise Before Passage': still dormant, but PROVISIONALLY PROTECTED rather than merely untouched. Because the player did not amplify the corrupted signal, the network was not woken incorrectly; one thread registered the promise. It remains a future opportunity, not a present liability.
